title: The introspective representations are not themselves phenomenally conscious

statements.text: The introspective representations that create the illusion must not themselves be phenomenally conscious, since explaining illusory phenomenal properties of experience by real phenomenal properties of introspective states would defeat the view. They may still be conscious in the psychological sense of being globally available.

sources.quote: It would be self-defeating to explain illusory phenomenal properties of experience in terms of real phenomenal properties of introspective states.
they could be conscious in the psychological sense of being globally available
